searchText: ... how about `SUDO` `UDO`? This is actually my personal favorite, if it wasn't so long 😦 Has anyone thought much about the ｍｉｎｉｍａｌ version? I think I'm going to switch to that tonight if I don't hear any objections. Minimal version? https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-3074-sponsored-transaction-precompile/4880/22?u=samwilsn tl;dr only sign over type, invoker, chainid, and some hash value. Ugh, I hate that Discourse doesn't auto-subscribe you to things you reply to. I don't really like Discourse much at all ^^;; Ahah! FWIW Microsoft does use the term "impersonate" in their security contexts for things kind of "su-ish" (it's been forever since I've done any Win32 programming so don't remember the specifics): https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/secgloss/i-gly i realized the other day that `CALLCODE` already break the `*CALL` scheme, so i don't see any reason to not go with `CALLFROM` or `CALLAS` now my preference is `CALLFROM` as it is more readable That's three for `CALLFROM` I prefer `CALLAS` because we don't set origin. That said, I think this is as close as we're gonna get to consensus on a name 😛 I don't consider `ORIGIN` to have anything to do with `FROM`, so it makes `CALLFROM` an easier choice for me. 😄 Transactions don't come from the origin? In any case, here's the next revision of 3074, hot off my keyboard: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-3074.md
